With his brother Yuli, he built Ofer Brothers before establishing a separate maritime group in Europe. His family's interests expanded into cruise lines, property, banking and industrial companies.

long_biography.plain_text:
The Rambam hospital in Haifa lay close to Sammy Ofer's childhood neighbourhood. The Israeli shipowner helped finance a protected underground hospital intended to maintain treatment during emergencies, as well as improvements to existing wards. He also established a medicines fund for patients unable to afford cancer drugs outside the state's health coverage.

In Britain, Ofer supported the preservation and study of maritime history. His donation helped the National Maritime Museum in Greenwich build a new wing with exhibition and research facilities. He also contributed to the conservation of the Cutty Sark.

confidence.reason: Hospital award citation describes the facilities and medicines fund; project funder confirms the museum wing and personal memorial records Cutty Sark support.
